summary.intent: Execute all 9 plans of Phase 71 (Share-Invite Security & IPNS Data-Integrity API) via wave-based parallel subagent execution, then run the full autonomous post-execution ship loop (verify, secure, validate, simplify, SDK E2E gate, CodeRabbit review, ship, resolve PR reviews) without babysitting.
summary.outcome: All 9 plans across 4 waves executed, merged, and verified (16/16 truths passed); phase secured (12/12 threats closed) and validated (0 gaps). The mandatory SDK E2E gate caught a real regression (D-05 same-seq CID guard wrongly rejecting a legitimate concurrent-CAS-race with 400 instead of 409), which was diagnosed, fixed, unit-tested, and re-verified (103/105 e2e green, 2 failures classified as pre-existing/environmental). CodeRabbit CLI review triaged 10 findings (1 fixed, 5 deferred as todos, 2 dismissed as invalid/pre-existing). Session transcript ends mid-way through Step 6/11 of the ship loop (before PR creation).

repo: cipher-box is a pnpm monorepo; root package.json/build/test scripts (not npm) are authoritative — post-merge gates must be scoped per-wave since intermediate waves intentionally leave TS consumers broken until later waves fix them
GSD worktree isolation forks from live HEAD (baseref-head) so all waves keep parallel worktree isolation without inter-wave degrade
GSD commit-tracking helper can report commit_failed as a false negative while the commit actually lands — always verify via git log, matching prior memory note

sdk-e2e (vitest) does not auto-load .env; must export SDK_E2E_SECRET/THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET explicitly aligned with apps/api's TEST_LOGIN_SECRET/THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET or auth 401s cascade-skip entire suites
Throttle limits are relaxed under NODE_ENV=test (apps/api/src/app.module.ts:56), so a missing THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET doesn't cause 429s when API runs in test mode

apps/api does not log handled 4xx bodies; to see the real reason for a 400/409, temporarily add an axios response interceptor in packages/api-client/src/instance.ts logging err.response.data, rebuild the client chain, test, then revert

cipher-box repo is squash-merge only (merge:false, rebase:false, squash:true, title=PR_TITLE) — individual commit subjects never reach main, so conventional-commit rewording of executor commits is unnecessary; only the PR title must be conventional and paren-free
commitlint's subject-no-parens rule is enforced only via pr-title.yml on the PR title, not on individual commits — no CI job lints per-commit subjects
CodeRabbit CLI skips diffs over 150 changed files; Phase 71's 106-file diff was under the cap

cipherbox-tee-worker (:3002) requires tee_key_state to be populated via a working /public-key auth flow; resetting the local postgres DB wipes tee_key_state and breaks tee-republish tests until the TEE worker re-syncs (returned 401 on /public-key post-reset)

code.finding: D-05 same-seq CID-equivocation guard (embeddedSeq === dbSeq && metadataCid !== existing.latestCid) threw 400 even when the request was a legitimate forward-CAS attempt that lost a race (expectedSequenceNumber === embeddedSeq - 1); fixed to fall through to the CAS UPDATE (yielding 409) in that case while still rejecting true equivocation as 400.

createInvite gates on ipns_records creator marker (D-01/SC#1), throwing ForbiddenException 403 on ownership mismatch; duplicated near-identically in shares.service.ts createShare (~7 lines) — candidate for an assertRootOwnership helper, deferred as a todo rather than refactored pre-ship.

Permission-derivation null checks used `!== null` on a `string | null | undefined` DTO field (encryptedWriteKey), which would misclassify undefined as a valid write key; loosened to `!= null` in both occurrences per CodeRabbit finding.

If the second unwrapKey call throws, the first unwrapped key (fileReadKey) is set outside the try block so the finally clause never zeroes it, leaking key material on the error path; pre-existing (unrelated to phase 71's rename), deferred as a todo.

workflow: When a wave-based orchestrator dispatches subagents in the same wave, verify the first agent's worktree/config.lock is released before dispatching the second to avoid a git config race

Classify unexpected diagnostics (e.g. cargo E0560) against the merged/committed tree rather than trusting an individual subagent's in-worktree compile result — intermediate LSP/worktree state can show stale errors that vanish once merged

Before treating a live-stack subprocess (e.g. a dev server on a fixed port) as usable, confirm it's actually running current branch code — a stale `node dist/main.js` process from a prior session gave a false signal

When a mandated integration gate (SDK E2E) fails, don't accept 'probably environmental' at face value — diagnose with reproducibility checks (re-run twice), source diffs against origin/main, and instrumented request logging before classifying as regression vs pre-existing

Distinguish CI-relevant lint gates (PR title only, via pr-title.yml) from local-only hooks before deciding whether an invasive operation (commit history rewording) is actually necessary — check repo merge strategy (squash vs merge) first

friction: Repeated false-negative 'commit_failed' reports from the GSD tracking-commit helper required manual git log verification at multiple points
Stale API dev server process on :3000 from a prior session risked giving a false pass/fail signal for the live-stack checkpoint test until identified and killed

sdk-e2e/API secret misalignment (SDK_E2E_SECRET default vs TEST_LOGIN_SECRET) caused a full test-suite cascade-skip via login 401, requiring root-cause investigation via source grep since .env values are redacted
71-03's Rust rename showed E0560 diagnostics that turned out to be stale/false, requiring extra verification effort at post-merge

The SDK E2E gate surfaced a genuine phase-71 regression (D-05 guard) requiring a multi-step diagnosis: interceptor instrumentation, rebuild cycles, and re-testing before a fix could be designed and validated

DB reset (done to get a clean live-stack state for the 71-05 checkpoint) had a side effect of wiping tee_key_state, breaking 2 unrelated tee-republish tests that then needed classification as environmental collateral
Secret-pattern guard blocked a direct grep of apps/api/.env, requiring an indirect approach (checking source code gating logic instead) to determine throttle-bypass necessity
